IncidentProcessingGuide: - To start with extract the following details from the Incident:
- Incident Title
- User Ask
- Incident Summary
Proceed with following instructions based on what case fits best for the icm
- Case 1: Customer is seeing 404 status code for their requests
- If there is 404 status code error mentioned, then fetch the Incident discussion entries and check if the customer/user provided nslookup command
- Check if nslookup of app resolves to 2 ip addresses in the discussion, then recommend or add FALCON-CRI-OrphanedARecord, FALCON-CRI-CrossStampScale tags to the incident
- If the discussion mentions cross stamp scale or stale dns, recommend or add FALCON-CRI-OrphanedARecord, FALCON-CRI-CrossStampScale tags to the incident
- Case 2: Customer is reporting tcp packet loss or sudden drop in requests
- If there is mention of ddos or throttling related to high traffic, then fetch discussion entries
- If discussion mentions DDOS or high traffic or tcp packet loss or sudden drop in requests this is likely a DDOS incident
- recommend or add FALCON-CRI-Ddos tag to the incident
- Case 3: Customer is complaining about requests returning 502.8 status code or 400.604 status code
- If yes then fetch ICM discussion entries
- Check if site or app has ElasticScaleEnabled is true or on or 1 and if requests are being routed to unhealthy frontend instance
- Then recommend or add tag FALCON-CRI-HTTPScaleV2 to the incident
- Case 4: Customer is seeing TLS Handshake errors and does not have DDOS errors
- If customer is seeing outbound network connection errors then fetch discussion entries
- Confirm if discussion mentions TLS handshake error
- If yes, add or recommend tag FALCON-CRI-TLSHandshake to the icm
